title: Microsoft Fabric - Simply Explained
description:
Everyone talks about Microsoft Fabric, but few can explain what it actually is. This episode walks business and IT folks through OneLake, lakehouses, warehouses, data integration, real-time intelligence and Power BI in plain English. You will understand how the pieces fit together and why one copy of data changes everything.
In this episode
00:00 – What is Microsoft Fabric?00:33 – Why data was broken01:40 – What Fabric actually is02:45 – OneLake and shortcuts04:26 – Lakehouses and warehouses07:41 – Getting data in09:35 – Real-time intelligence and AI11:21 – Power BI, governance and value
Key takeaways
Microsoft Fabric is a unified SaaS data and analytics platform that brings data engineering, integration, warehousing, real-time analytics and BI together under one login.OneLake is the single data lake per tenant in open Delta Parquet format, and shortcuts let you reference external data without copying it.Power BI in Fabric reads OneLake data directly via Direct Lake, while Purview sensitivity labels, DLP and domains provide governance from the start.
Worth quoting
“More time was spent moving data between systems, than actually analyzing it. Data integration became a full-time job for entire teams.” – Mirko Peters (01:13)
“The easiest way to think about one lake is like one drive for your data.” – Mirko Peters (02:52)
